04907_553dcd423e6da03fc4942ea98fcb90d4.p.description: Infografik berjudul 'HOW TO STUDY IN THE LIBRARY' dengan subjudul: 'Studying in the library is a good way to focus and learn. Follow these steps to use your time well:' memuat 6 langkah studi: 1. 'PREPARE YOUR MATERIALS': 'Bring your books, notes, stationery, and water. Make sure you also have your library card.' (disertai ikon buku, catatan, dan botol air). 2. 'CHOOSE QUIET SPOT': 'Find a table with good light and little noise. Avoid sitting too close to the entrance or the restroom.' (disertai ikon meja belajar dengan lampu). 3. 'SET A STUDY GOAL': 'Decide what you want to finish, such as reading two chapters or writing an essay' (disertai ikon target sasaran / stopwatch). 4. 'FOLLOW LIBRARY RULES': 'Speak softly, keep your phone on silent, and do not eat inside. Respect other students.' (disertai tiga simbol larangan). 5. 'TAKE SHORT BREAKS': 'After one hour, stand up, stretch, or walk for five minutes. This will help you stay fresh' (disertai ikon orang berjalan dan meregangkan tubuh). 6. 'REVIEW BEFORE LEAVING': 'Check your notes, organize your books, and return borrowed materials.' (disertai ikon daftar periksa). Teks penutup di bagian bawah: 'With these steps, your library study time will be effective'.
